name: Side Bowl of Warm Steamed Jasmine White Rice
whyItWorks: Pure steamed jasmine white rice is the ultimate soothing staple in DCA. It calms nausea, slows bowel transit, requires minimal digestive work, and contains zero dairy, gluten, or seeds.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order an extra side bowl of plain steamed white rice. Eat plain or lightly seasoned with soy sauce.
